meta.name: text-to-speech
meta.description: Convert text to natural speech with Inworld TTS, ElevenLabs, DIA TTS, Kokoro, Chatterbox, and more via inference.sh CLI. Models: Inworld TTS-2 (100+ languages, emotion steering), Inworld TTS 1.5 (ultra-low latency), ElevenLabs (premium, 22+ voices, 32 languages), DIA TTS (conversational), Kokoro TTS, Chatterbox, Higgs Audio, VibeVoice (podcasts). Capabilities: text-to-speech, voice cloning, multi-speaker dialogue, podcast generation, expressive speech, emotion/delivery steering, character voices. Use for: voiceovers, audiobooks, podcasts, accessibility, video narration, IVR, voice assistants, gaming characters, avatar audio. Triggers: text to speech, tts, voice generation, ai voice, speech synthesis, voice over, generate speech, ai narrator, voice cloning, text to audio, elevenlabs, eleven labs, voice ai, ai voiceover, speech generator, natural voice, inworld, inworld tts, character voice, game voice, npc voice

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文字转为自然语音，支持多种AI语音引擎
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将文字内容转为高质量语音
copy.tagline_en: Convert text to natural speech with multiple AI voice engines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn text into high-quality speech

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过命令行将文字转为自然语音，支持多种语音模型，包括情感控制、多说话人对话、播客生成等功能。
howto.when: 当你要求将文字转为语音，或提到“文字转语音”、“TTS”、“语音生成”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请把这段话转成语音：欢迎使用我们的产品。
say.note: 使用 Kokoro TTS 生成语音。

say.text: 用兴奋的语气说：我们达到了一百万用户！
say.note: 使用 Inworld TTS-2 的情感控制功能。

say.text: 生成一个播客脚本的语音。
say.note: 使用 VibeVoice 生成长篇音频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert text to natural speech via command line, supporting multiple TTS models with features like emotion steering, multi-speaker dialogue, and podcast generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert text to speech, or mention keywords like 'text to speech', 'TTS', 'voice generation', etc.

say_en.text: Convert this text to speech: Welcome to our product.
say_en.note: Uses Kokoro TTS to generate speech.

say_en.text: Say in an excited tone: We hit one million users!
Generate speech for a podcast script.
